title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 14
statement: Jami picked three equally spaced integer numbers on the number line. The sum of the first and the second numbers is \(40,\) while the sum of the second and third numbers is \(60.\) What is the sum of all three numbers?

solutions.text: Let the three equally spaced numbers be \(a-d\), \(a\), and \(a+d\). The given sums are \(2a-d=40\) and \(2a+d=60\). Adding gives \(4a=100\), so \(a=25\). The total of the three numbers is \(3a=75\).
hints: Let the three numbers be \(a-d, a, a+d\)
The two given sums differ by \(20\), so \(2d=20\)
